An ADU with a roof constructed pursuant to Section U202.3 or U202.4 shall be exempt from the requirements for a sustainable roofing zone pursuant to Section 1512 for any roof construction attributed to such ADU.
(L.L. 2024/127, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
Section BC U201: Above Grade ADU Within a One-Family Primary Dwelling
